why: An ad the shape rule hid, with something changing inside it afterwards - a video loading. A hidden post is re-checked whenever it changes, by looking for the label that hid it, and a shape-rule hide has no label: every change gave the ad back, and it flashed up until the next sweep hid it again, up to half a second later. It is now re-checked against what put it there: a link off Facebook or an ad button.
